body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy adjacent after your movement.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 2 units toward a creature that moved since your last turn. On success, deal 1 Slashing Damage.

surges.html: After a hit, ignore the target's movement Reactions until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Adaptation - Predator
rider.html: Assume Pursuit Sinews (upkeep 0): once on each of your turns, when you replace this Adaptation with another, move 1 unit toward a visible enemy.
